audit_items.proof_trace: The admin access gate in `admin/layout.tsx` (L18-22) queries `members` for `is_admin` without `.is('deleted_at', null)`, so a soft-deleted admin user whose session remains active passes the check and retains full admin access. `deleteMember()` (members.ts:524-527) only sets `deleted_at` and never clears `is_admin`, and `checkAdmin()` (members.ts:65) used by all admin server actions has the same missing filter — compounding the bypass. Separately, `oauth/token/route.ts:124-128` also omits the filter, allowing a deleted member's auth code to be exchanged for a valid JWT bearing their profile data.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A deleted admin user with an active Supabase session navigates to `/dashboard/admin/members`; `admin/layout.tsx` returns their record with `is_admin=true` (no deleted_at check) and grants access, allowing them to perform all admin operations (bulk member updates, role sync, etc.) until their session expires.
